categories.path: 內分泌/新陳代謝 > 性激素 > Progestin

items.text: Progesterone：活化progesterone receptor → 使子宮內膜分泌化、降低子宮收縮、增厚子宮頸黏液。
用於：避孕、黃體素補充、異常子宮出血、子宮內膜保護。
考點：progestin讓內膜穩定，搭配estrogen防子宮內膜增生。
常考/禁忌：乳房脹、情緒變化、嗜睡、水腫；血栓風險依製劑/合併estrogen而定。

statements.text: Activates progesterone receptors and converts an estrogen-primed proliferative endometrium to a secretory endometrium.
Produces progestational endometrial effects and can cause clinically relevant sedation and dizziness after oral dosing.
Opposes estrogen-driven endometrial proliferation when used with conjugated estrogens in women with a uterus.
Prevention of endometrial hyperplasia with conjugated estrogens and treatment of secondary amenorrhea.
Common reactions include headache, breast tenderness, dizziness, abdominal symptoms, mood effects, and somnolence.
Serious risks reported with estrogen-progestin therapy include thromboembolism, stroke, malignancy, and severe hypersensitivity; risk attribution depends on the combined regimen.
Contraindications include peanut allergy for this formulation, unexplained genital bleeding, breast cancer, active or prior thromboembolism/arterial thrombosis, and liver disease.
Take at bedtime because transient dizziness and drowsiness can occur; evaluate abnormal bleeding and cardiovascular or malignant risk before therapy.
Peak serum concentrations generally occur within 3 hours after oral administration.
Progesterone is approximately 96% to 99% protein bound and is extensively metabolized in the liver.
CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase progesterone exposure; combined estrogen therapy contributes additional interaction and safety considerations.
Monitor abnormal uterine bleeding, excessive sedation, edema, and signs of thromboembolism when used with estrogen.
Use during pregnancy is not indicated in this labeling; available epidemiologic data do not show a clear congenital-anomaly association with early progestin exposure.
Progesterone is present in human milk; weigh breastfeeding benefits, maternal need, and potential infant effects.
Overdose management is supportive, with attention to somnolence, dizziness, and other exaggerated progestational effects.
Exam scope must distinguish natural oral progesterone from synthetic contraceptive progestins; the reviewed label directly supports endometrial protection and secondary amenorrhea.

categories.path: 心臟科 > 心絞痛 > Late Na current抑制

items.text: Ranolazine：抑制late Na+ current → 細胞內Na/Ca負荷下降，改善舒張與缺血。
慢性心絞痛輔助。
考點：不太影響HR/BP，但會QT延長。
常考/禁忌：QT延長、暈、便祕、噁心；CYP3A交互作用。

statements.text: Inhibits the cardiac late sodium current; the exact relationship of this action to antianginal benefit has not been fully determined.
Prolongs QTc in a dose- and concentration-related manner through IKr inhibition.
Reduces angina frequency and improves exercise performance with minimal average effects on heart rate and blood pressure.
Treatment of chronic angina; it may be used with beta blockers, nitrates, calcium-channel blockers, antiplatelet therapy, lipid-lowering therapy, ACE inhibitors, and ARBs.
Most common adverse reactions are dizziness, headache, constipation, and nausea.
Clinically important toxicities include QT prolongation, syncope, renal failure in severe renal impairment, and neurologic effects at high exposure.
Contraindicated with strong CYP3A inhibitors or inducers and in patients with liver cirrhosis.
Use caution with other QT-prolonging factors and monitor renal function in moderate-to-severe renal impairment.
Peak plasma concentrations occur 2 to 5 hours after dosing and steady state is generally reached within 3 days.
The apparent terminal half-life is approximately 7 hours.
Strong CYP3A inhibitors/inducers are prohibited; moderate CYP3A inhibitors require a dose cap, and ranolazine can affect CYP2D6, P-gp, and OCT2 substrates.
Monitor ECG/QT risk, renal function, dizziness/syncope, and interacting-drug exposure.
Pregnancy data are insufficient to determine a drug-associated risk.
Human-milk data are unavailable; consider breastfeeding benefits, maternal need, and potential infant risk.
Overdose can intensify dizziness, nausea, hypotension, diplopia, confusion, and QT prolongation; provide supportive care and continuous ECG monitoring.
Ranolazine is a late-sodium-current antianginal with QT liability and major CYP3A constraints, not a drug whose benefit is explained by lowering heart rate.

categories.path: 風濕免疫科 > 生物製劑 > Anti-CD20

items.text: Rituximab：抗CD20單株抗體 → B細胞耗竭。
用於：B細胞淋巴瘤、CLL、RA、ANCA血管炎等。
考點：anti-CD20；HBV再活化與PML要記。
常考/禁忌：輸注反應、感染、HBV再活化、PML、低免疫球蛋白。

statements.text: Binds CD20 on pre-B and mature B lymphocytes and mediates B-cell lysis through complement-dependent cytotoxicity and antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity.
Causes rapid peripheral B-cell depletion; recovery often begins after about 6 months and may take longer.
Provides antitumor and immunomodulatory effects across labeled B-cell malignancies and autoimmune diseases.
Labeled uses include selected NHL, CLL, rheumatoid arthritis, GPA/MPA, and pemphigus vulgaris.
Common reactions include infusion-related reactions, fever, chills, infections, and cytopenias, with incidence varying by indication and regimen.
Serious risks include fatal infusion reactions, severe mucocutaneous reactions, hepatitis B reactivation, progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy, infection, and cytopenias.
The reviewed RITUXAN label lists no formal contraindications.
Premedicate and monitor infusions; screen for HBV before treatment and monitor for HBV reactivation, infection, PML, cardiac, renal, and hematologic toxicity.
Serum rituximab may remain detectable for months after treatment.
In NHL studies, estimated median terminal elimination half-life was approximately 22 days after repeated dosing.
Concomitant biologic immunosuppression and live vaccines require caution; no formal drug-interaction studies establish broad safety.
Monitor CBC, infusion vital signs, HBV serology/reactivation, infection, neurologic changes, renal function, and cardiac symptoms in at-risk patients.
Exposure during pregnancy can cause fetal/neonatal B-cell lymphocytopenia; advise effective contraception during therapy and for 12 months afterward.
Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment and for 6 months after the last dose.
No specific antidote is established; stop infusion and manage toxicity supportively with appropriate monitoring.
Anti-CD20 depletion explains both efficacy and infection/HBV risks; the four boxed-warning themes are infusion reaction, mucocutaneous reaction, HBV reactivation, and PML.

categories.path: 心臟科 > 心衰竭 > Neprilysin抑制

items.text: Sacubitril：Neprilysin inhibitor：減少natriuretic peptide分解 → 利鈉、血管擴張、抗重塑；臨床與valsartan合用。
用於：HFrEF降低死亡與住院。
考點：ARNI = sacubitril/valsartan；不能與ACEI同時用。
常考/禁忌：低血壓、高血鉀、腎功能惡化、血管性水腫；與ACEI需間隔36小時。

mnemonics.text: p.52: 篩骨被催(Sacubitril)-->鼻子就斷啦，你不能吸(Neprilysin inhibitor)🡺這時你會說”啊鼻 子”(要和ARB併用)
p.53: 篩骨被催(Sacubitril)-->鼻子就斷啦，你不能吸 (Neprilysin inhibitor)🡺這時你會說”啊鼻子”(要和ARB 併用)
p.52: 傻哭包(Sacubi-)哭完🡺心情放鬆🡺血管舒張

statements.text: Sacubitril is converted to LBQ657, which inhibits neprilysin; valsartan blocks the angiotensin II type-1 receptor.
Neprilysin inhibition increases vasoactive peptides, while AT1 blockade limits angiotensin-II effects; this paired mechanism is essential to the product.
Reduces cardiovascular death and heart-failure hospitalization in labeled heart-failure populations.
Treatment of chronic heart failure to reduce cardiovascular death and hospitalization, including age-appropriate pediatric heart failure under the label.
Common adverse reactions include hypotension, hyperkalemia, cough, dizziness, and renal failure/acute renal failure.
Serious risks include angioedema, fetal toxicity, symptomatic hypotension, renal impairment, and hyperkalemia.
Contraindicated with hypersensitivity/angioedema history, concomitant ACE-inhibitor use or within 36 hours of one, and aliskiren in diabetes.
Do not combine with an ACE inhibitor; monitor for angioedema, hypotension, worsening renal function, and hyperkalemia.
Median peak times are approximately 0.5 hour for sacubitril, 2 hours for LBQ657, and 1.5 hours for valsartan.
Mean elimination half-lives are approximately 1.4 hours for sacubitril, 11.5 hours for LBQ657, and 9.9 hours for valsartan.
Important interactions include ACE inhibitors, aliskiren, potassium-raising drugs, NSAIDs, and lithium.
Monitor blood pressure, potassium, renal function, and any facial/oropharyngeal swelling.
Boxed warning: discontinue as soon as pregnancy is detected because renin-angiotensin-system drugs can injure or kill the fetus.
Because of potential serious reactions in breastfed infants, breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment.
Hypotension is the most likely overdose manifestation; provide supportive treatment, and hemodialysis is unlikely to remove the highly protein-bound components.
Sacubitril must be taught as sacubitril/valsartan: neprilysin inhibition plus AT1 blockade, with a mandatory 36-hour ACE-inhibitor washout.

categories.path: 神經/精神科 > 抗帕金森 > MAO-B抑制

items.text: Selegiline：選擇性MAO-B inhibitor → 中樞dopamine分解下降。
用於：Parkinson輔助；高劑量/貼片可治憂鬱。
考點：MAO-B保留DA；高劑量失去選擇性。
常考/禁忌：失眠、噁心、姿勢性低血壓、dyskinesia；serotonin syndrome/tyramine風險高劑量。

mnemonics.text: p.30: 史萊哲林(selegiline)都很會喇賽(rasa-)和裝逼(MAO-B)
p.31: 吉林(-giline)很冷，貓咪(MAO B)不喜歡(抑制)

statements.text: Irreversibly inhibits MAO-B at recommended doses, reducing dopamine metabolism; selectivity diminishes as dose increases.
Augments and prolongs dopaminergic effects of levodopa, which may increase dyskinesia or other dopaminergic adverse effects.
Improves control when Parkinson response to levodopa/carbidopa has deteriorated.
Adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa in Parkinson disease patients whose response is deteriorating.
Common adverse reactions include dizziness, dyskinesia, insomnia, nausea/vomiting, constipation, rash, and myalgia.
Serious risks include serotonin syndrome, hypertensive reactions, falling asleep during activities, orthostatic hypotension, hallucinations, and impulse-control problems.
Contraindicated with meperidine and certain other opioids, other MAO inhibitors, St. John's wort, cyclobenzaprine, and dextromethorphan.
Do not exceed the recommended dose; higher exposure loses MAO-B selectivity and increases tyramine/serotonergic risk.
The orally disintegrating dose is rapidly absorbed, with measurable selegiline exposure within about 10 to 15 minutes.
Median terminal half-life is about 1.3 hours after a single dose and about 10 hours at steady state.
Avoid prohibited opioids, serotonergic antidepressants, other MAO inhibitors, sympathomimetics, and excess tyramine under relevant high-exposure conditions.
Monitor blood pressure, mental status, dyskinesia, somnolence, hallucinations, and impulse-control behaviors.
Human pregnancy data are insufficient to determine a drug-associated risk.
Breastfeeding is not recommended during ZELAPAR treatment and for 7 days after the final dose because serious infant reactions, including hypertensive reactions, are possible.
No dose adjustment is required in mild to moderate renal impairment; ZELAPAR is not recommended in severe renal impairment or end-stage renal disease.
MAO-inhibitor overdose may be delayed and can cause severe CNS, autonomic, cardiovascular, and hyperthermic toxicity; intensive supportive monitoring is required.
At recommended ZELAPAR doses selegiline is MAO-B selective; exam answers should preserve the dose-dependent loss of selectivity.

categories.path: 心臟科 > 降血脂 > Statins

items.text: Simvastatin：抑制HMG-CoA reductase → 肝膽固醇合成下降、LDL receptor上升 → LDL下降。
高LDL、ASCVD初/次級預防。
考點：降LDL一線；晚上吃常考（短效）。
常考/禁忌：肌痛/肌病/橫紋肌溶解、肝酵素上升、新發糖尿病少許；懷孕禁用，CYP交互作用依藥物。

statements.text: The active beta-hydroxyacid competitively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, reducing hepatic cholesterol synthesis and increasing LDL clearance.
Lowers LDL-C and triglycerides and can raise HDL-C; response depends on dose and baseline lipid status.
Reduces major cardiovascular events in indicated high-risk patients and treats primary lipid disorders.
Reduction of cardiovascular risk and treatment of primary hyperlipidemia and mixed dyslipidemia in appropriate patients.
Common reactions include upper respiratory infection, headache, abdominal pain, constipation, and nausea.
Serious toxicities include myopathy/rhabdomyolysis, immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy, hepatic injury, and marked CK elevation.
Contraindicated with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, cyclosporine, danazol, or gemfibrozil, and in acute liver failure/decompensated cirrhosis or hypersensitivity.
Stop or interrupt therapy for suspected myopathy, severe acute illness that raises renal-failure risk, or clinically significant hepatic injury.
Simvastatin is a lactone prodrug; peak plasma radioactivity occurs about 4 hours after an oral dose.
Systemic availability of active inhibitors is less than 5% and both simvastatin and its active metabolite are highly protein bound.
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and several lipid drugs markedly increase myopathy risk; grapefruit and dose-limited combinations require attention.
Monitor lipid response, muscle symptoms/CK when indicated, and hepatic tests before therapy and when clinically indicated.
Discontinue in most pregnant patients because lipid-lowering treatment is generally unnecessary during pregnancy.
Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment because serious infant adverse reactions are possible.
No specific antidote is established; treat overdose supportively and monitor for muscle, renal, and hepatic toxicity.
Simvastatin is a CYP3A4-sensitive lactone statin; the exam-critical harm is exposure-related myopathy/rhabdomyolysis.

categories.path: 風濕免疫科 > 免疫抑制 > mTOR抑制

items.text: Sirolimus：mTOR inhibitor：FKBP12-藥物複合體抑制mTOR → T細胞對IL-2反應下降。
用於：腎移植排斥預防；藥物塗層支架。
考點：不像calcineurin inhibitor，不抑制IL-2生成而抑制反應。
常考/禁忌：骨髓抑制、口腔潰瘍、高脂血症、傷口癒合差、肺炎；腎毒較CNI少。

mnemonics.text: p.87: 在西螺大橋(sirolimus)上騎摩托車(mTOR inhibitor)大聲地按喇叭(rapamycin)
p.87: 我騎摩托車(mTOR)去西螺(Siro-)，食物總是(Ever-)甜死(Temsi-)

statements.text: Binds FKBP-12; the complex inhibits mTOR and suppresses cytokine-driven T-cell activation and proliferation.
Inhibits IL-2-mediated T-cell proliferation downstream of cytokine production rather than inhibiting calcineurin.
Prevents renal-allograft rejection and improves lung-function measures in lymphangioleiomyomatosis under labeled regimens.
Prophylaxis of organ rejection after renal transplantation and treatment of lymphangioleiomyomatosis.
Common reactions include edema, hyperlipidemia, hypertension, abdominal pain, diarrhea, headache, fever, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and creatinine increase.
Serious risks include infection/malignancy, impaired wound healing, interstitial lung disease, proteinuria, cytopenias, and thrombotic microangiopathy.
Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to sirolimus.
Not recommended for liver or lung transplantation; monitor infection, malignancy, wound healing, pneumonitis, lipids, renal injury, and proteinuria.
Mean terminal elimination half-life after multiple dosing in stable renal-transplant patients is approximately 62 ± 16 hours.
Sirolimus is a CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein substrate and is extensively metabolized in the intestinal wall and liver.
Oral exposure is affected by food and dosage form; administer consistently with or without food.
Strong CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitors or inducers should be avoided; grapefruit can increase exposure.
Use therapeutic drug monitoring and follow CBC, lipids, renal function, urine protein, infection, wound healing, and pulmonary symptoms.
Can cause fetal harm; advise effective contraception during therapy and for 12 weeks after the last dose.
Breastfeeding is not recommended because of potential serious reactions in the breastfed infant.
Experience is limited; provide general supportive care, recognizing poor dialyzability because of high binding and distribution.
Sirolimus/rapamycin acts through FKBP-12-mTOR and blocks the response to IL-2; it is not a calcineurin inhibitor.

categories.path: 心臟科 > 利尿劑 > Aldosterone受器拮抗

items.text: Spironolactone：阻斷collecting duct mineralocorticoid receptor → ENaC/Na-K ATPase表現下降 → 保鉀利尿。
用於：HFrEF、肝硬化腹水、原發性高醛固酮、高血壓。
考點：保鉀利尿；spironolactone有抗androgen。
常考/禁忌：高K、代謝性酸中毒；spironolactone抗雄性素造成男性女乳/性功能障礙，eplerenone較少。

mnemonics.text: p.78: 林秉樞在他媽的(-tamide)喪禮後脅迫他人(cyproterone)，俘虜(Flu-)高嘉瑜，揍她揍到掰咖 (bica-)，嚇得她屁滾尿流(利尿劑Spironolactone)，真不配當男人(androgen blocker)

statements.text: Competitively antagonizes aldosterone at mineralocorticoid receptors in the distal nephron, increasing sodium/water excretion while retaining potassium.
Produces potassium-sparing natriuresis and has antiandrogenic/progestational effects that contribute to endocrine adverse reactions.
Improves outcomes in selected heart-failure patients and reduces edema, blood pressure, and manifestations of aldosterone excess.
Heart failure, add-on hypertension treatment, edema from cirrhosis/nephrotic syndrome, and diagnosis/treatment of primary hyperaldosteronism.
Clinically important recurring reactions include hyperkalemia, gynecomastia, menstrual irregularity, gastrointestinal symptoms, dizziness, and sexual dysfunction.
Serious risks include severe hyperkalemia, hypotension, worsening renal function, electrolyte disturbances, and severe cutaneous reactions.
Contraindicated in hyperkalemia, Addison disease, or concomitant eplerenone use.
Check potassium within one week of initiation or titration and regularly thereafter; monitor volume status and renal function.
Spironolactone peaks at about 2.6 hours and is rapidly converted to active metabolites.
Spironolactone half-life is about 1.4 hours; active metabolites have half-lives around 14 to 17 hours and are highly protein bound.
Potassium supplements, ACE inhibitors/ARBs, NSAIDs, heparin, lithium, digoxin, and trimethoprim can cause important interactions.
Monitor potassium, renal function, blood pressure, volume status, and endocrine adverse effects.
Avoid in pregnancy when possible because antiandrogenic activity may affect male fetal sexual differentiation.
Spironolactone is not detected in milk, but its active metabolite canrenone appears in low amounts; consider infant risk and maternal need.
Overdose may cause drowsiness, confusion, rash, gastrointestinal symptoms, hyperkalemia, and dehydration; treatment is supportive.
Spironolactone blocks the mineralocorticoid receptor; amiloride and triamterene are the direct ENaC blockers.

categories.path: 腸胃科 > 消化性潰瘍 > 黏膜保護

items.text: Sucralfate：在潰瘍表面形成保護層或增加黏膜防禦，隔絕酸與胃蛋白酶。
用於：消化性潰瘍、NSAID或H. pylori相關潰瘍輔助。
考點：sucralfate需酸性環境，會影響藥物吸收。
常考/禁忌：便祕、鋁累積（腎差）、黑便/舌（bismuth）、藥物吸收下降。

statements.text: In acidic conditions forms a viscous, adhesive complex that binds preferentially to ulcer sites and protects against acid, pepsin, and bile salts.
Acts predominantly at the gastrointestinal mucosal surface; only small amounts of the sulfated disaccharide are absorbed.
Promotes healing of active duodenal ulcers and can maintain healing after acute treatment.
Short-term treatment of active duodenal ulcer and maintenance therapy after healing at the labeled dose.
Constipation is the most frequent adverse reaction; dry mouth, nausea, rash, and other reactions occur less often.
Serious concerns include hypersensitivity, bezoar formation, aspiration complications, and aluminum accumulation in chronic renal failure.
Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to active or excipient components.
Use cautiously in chronic renal failure because absorbed aluminum can accumulate; dysphagia or impaired gastric emptying increases bezoar/aspiration risk.
Systemic absorption of intact sucralfate is minimal after oral administration.
The small absorbed sulfated disaccharide fraction is excreted mainly in urine.
Sucralfate can reduce absorption of multiple oral drugs through gastrointestinal binding; separate doses when an interaction is clinically important.
Monitor ulcer symptoms, adherence/timing, constipation, swallowing risk, and aluminum toxicity in renal impairment.
Animal studies have not shown fetal harm, but adequate pregnancy studies are lacking; use only if clearly needed.
It is unknown whether sucralfate is excreted in human milk; use caution during nursing.
Acute overdose experience suggests mainly gastrointestinal symptoms; provide supportive management.
Sucralfate is a local ulcer barrier with minimal absorption; the reviewed label does not establish ICU stress-ulcer treatment or NSAID-ulcer prevention.

sources.title: SUCRALFATE — current U.S. labeling

categories.path: 感染科 > 抗生素 > Sulfonamide

items.text: Sulfamethoxazole：是PABA類似物，抑制dihydropteroate synthase → 細菌葉酸合成前段下降。
UTI、Nocardia、PJP（TMP-SMX）、MRSA皮膚感染等依合併。
考點：sulfa + TMP 是葉酸路徑前後夾殺。
常考/禁忌：過敏/SJS、G6PD溶血、kernicterus、腎結晶、光敏感；孕晚期/新生兒避免。

statements.text: Sulfamethoxazole competitively inhibits bacterial dihydropteroate synthase; trimethoprim blocks the next folate step, producing sequential inhibition.
The combination is generally bactericidal in vitro at concentrations where each component alone may be bacteriostatic.
Treats susceptible bacterial infections and Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia under the labeled combination regimen.
Labeled combination uses include selected UTIs, acute otitis media, bronchitis exacerbations, shigellosis, PJP, and travelers' diarrhea.
Most common reactions are gastrointestinal disturbances and allergic skin reactions such as rash and urticaria.
Serious risks include SJS/TEN/DRESS, hepatic necrosis, severe blood dyscrasias, anaphylaxis, pulmonary injury, and hyperkalemia.

Contraindications include sulfonamide/trimethoprim hypersensitivity, immune thrombocytopenia, megaloblastic anemia from folate deficiency, age under 2 months, marked hepatic damage, unmonitorable severe renal insufficiency, and dofetilide.
Stop promptly for rash or severe reaction; monitor for cytopenias, liver injury, pulmonary toxicity, hyperkalemia, and renal crystalluria.
Both components are rapidly absorbed, with peak blood levels generally 1 to 4 hours after oral dosing.
Mean serum half-lives are approximately 10 hours for sulfamethoxazole and 8 to 10 hours for trimethoprim; both are prolonged in severe renal impairment.
Important interactions include warfarin, phenytoin, methotrexate, digoxin, oral hypoglycemics, RAAS drugs, and dofetilide.
Monitor CBC, renal and hepatic function, potassium, hydration, and relevant interacting-drug effects during clinically significant courses.
The combination may cause fetal harm through folate-pathway effects; use in pregnancy only when benefit justifies risk.
Both components are present in human milk; avoid in premature, jaundiced, ill, or G6PD-deficient infants because of kernicterus/hemolysis risk.
Overdose may cause nausea, vomiting, dizziness, mental effects, crystalluria, hematuria, and marrow suppression; provide supportive care and monitor blood counts/electrolytes.
Sulfamethoxazole blocks dihydropteroate synthase and must be kept in the TMP-SMX combination scope for the reviewed indications.

sources.title: SULFAMETHOXAZOLE AND TRIMETHOPRIM — current U.S. labeling

categories.path: 內分泌/新陳代謝 > 性激素 > SERM

items.text: Tamoxifen：SERM：乳房為ER antagonist；骨/子宮部分agonist。
用於：ER陽性乳癌治療/預防。
考點：乳房抗雌激素，但子宮像雌激素。
常考/禁忌：熱潮紅、血栓、子宮內膜癌風險、白內障。

mnemonics.text: p.80: 他摸(tamo-)，他只能摸乳房🡺只對乳房是antagonist；對子宮內膜就是agonist

statements.text: Competes with estrogen for estrogen-receptor binding in target tissues and forms a nuclear complex that reduces estrogen-dependent gene expression in breast tissue.
Acts predominantly as an estrogen antagonist in breast but can exert estrogen-like effects in bone, lipids, and endometrium.
Reduces recurrence and mortality in appropriate breast-cancer settings and lowers invasive-breast-cancer risk in selected high-risk patients.
Metastatic and adjuvant breast cancer, ductal carcinoma in situ after surgery/radiation, and breast-cancer risk reduction in selected high-risk women.
Common reactions include hot flashes, vaginal discharge/bleeding, menstrual changes, nausea, and fluid retention.
Serious risks include endometrial malignancy, uterine sarcoma, venous thromboembolism, pulmonary embolism, stroke, cataracts, and hepatic abnormalities.
For risk-reduction/DCIS use, contraindications include concurrent coumarin anticoagulants or prior DVT/PE; hypersensitivity is also a contraindication.
Investigate abnormal vaginal bleeding and monitor for thromboembolism, stroke, ocular changes, and hepatic or lipid abnormalities.
Peak plasma concentrations occur about 5 hours after oral dosing.
Tamoxifen has a terminal half-life of about 5 to 7 days; N-desmethyltamoxifen has a longer half-life around 14 days.
Coumarin anticoagulant effects may be enhanced; strong CYP2D6 inhibition can reduce active-metabolite formation, and cytotoxic regimens can increase thromboembolic risk.
Monitor gynecologic symptoms/examination, thromboembolic symptoms, eye complaints, liver tests, CBC, and calcium in metastatic bone disease.
Tamoxifen can cause fetal harm; exclude pregnancy and use effective nonhormonal contraception during therapy and for the label-specified period afterward.
Breastfeeding is not recommended because tamoxifen can suppress lactation and may cause serious infant reactions.
Very high exposure has caused neurologic effects and QT changes; provide supportive care because no specific antidote is established.
Tamoxifen is breast-antagonistic but has partial estrogenic endometrial effects, explaining its uterine-cancer warning.
Raloxifene—not tamoxifen—is the SERM directly labeled for treatment and prevention of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women; the legacy -loxifene mnemonic segment is reassigned to raloxifene.

categories.path: 胸腔科 > 抗氣喘/COPD > Methylxanthines

items.text: Theophylline：Methylxanthine：抑制PDE並拮抗adenosine → cAMP↑支氣管擴張。
用於：氣喘/COPD輔助治療（治療窗窄，現在少用）。
考點：PDE抑制＋adenosine拮抗；代謝受CYP影響。
常考/禁忌：心律不整、癲癇、噁心嘔吐、失眠；治療窗窄。

mnemonics.text: p.62: 學霸的名次誰要分你(theophylline)，想拚第一(抑制PDE)，不屑甘(腺苷adenosine抑制)於 第二名
p.62: Q：名次誰要分你(theophylline) A：阿明分你(Aminophylline)

statements.text: The bronchodilator mechanism is not fully established; proposed actions include phosphodiesterase inhibition and adenosine-receptor antagonism at relevant concentrations.
Relaxes bronchial smooth muscle and can increase diaphragmatic contractility, but concentration-related cardiac and CNS stimulation limits dosing.
Provides maintenance bronchodilation and symptom control in chronic asthma and reversible airflow obstruction.
Treatment of symptoms and reversible airflow obstruction associated with chronic asthma and other chronic lung diseases such as emphysema/chronic bronchitis.
Concentration-related common reactions include nausea, vomiting, headache, insomnia, restlessness, and tremor.
Toxic concentrations can cause persistent vomiting, life-threatening tachyarrhythmias, and seizures.
Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to theophylline or product components.
Do not increase dose for an acute exacerbation; reduce/hold and obtain a serum level when toxicity, fever, organ dysfunction, or interacting-drug changes occur.
Theophylline half-life varies widely; the label table reports a mean of 8.7 hours (range 6.1 to 12.8 hours) in otherwise healthy nonsmoking adults with asthma.
Theophylline is rapidly and completely absorbed, but extended-release food and formulation effects require consistent administration.
Hepatic metabolism and clearance vary markedly with age, smoking, fever, heart failure, liver disease, and interacting drugs.
Many CYP inhibitors increase and inducers decrease clearance; smoking status and xanthine-containing products also alter exposure or toxicity.
Monitor serum theophylline concentrations, symptoms, heart rhythm when indicated, and changes in smoking, fever, hepatic/cardiac disease, or interacting drugs.
Use in pregnancy only when potential benefit justifies fetal risk; physiologic clearance changes can affect concentrations.
Theophylline is excreted in human milk and may cause irritability or other mild toxicity in nursing infants.
Overdose requires serial levels, cardiac monitoring, seizure control, decontamination when appropriate, and enhanced elimination for severe poisoning.
Theophylline has a narrow therapeutic window: nausea and insomnia may precede seizures or arrhythmias, and clearance changes are exam-critical.

categories.path: 神經/精神科 > 類鴉片止痛劑 > 弱/中效μ致效

items.text: Tramadol：活化μ-opioid receptor（Gi）→ presynaptic Ca2+下降、postsynaptic K+上升 → 痛覺傳遞下降。
用於：中重度疼痛、麻醉、咳嗽/腹瀉（依藥物）。
考點：比一般opioid更要想到癲癇與serotonin syndrome。
常考/禁忌：呼吸抑制、便秘、噁心、瞳孔縮小、成癮、低血壓；naloxone逆轉。

statements.text: Parent drug and active M1 metabolite act at mu-opioid receptors; tramadol also inhibits norepinephrine and serotonin reuptake.
Produces analgesia and dose-related respiratory/CNS depression; serotonergic and noradrenergic activity contributes additional interaction risk.
Relieves severe pain requiring an opioid when alternative treatments are inadequate.
Management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate.
Common reactions include dizziness/vertigo, nausea, constipation, headache, somnolence, and vomiting.
Serious risks include fatal respiratory depression, addiction/misuse, seizures, serotonin syndrome, neonatal withdrawal, adrenal insufficiency, and severe hypotension.

Contraindicated in children under 12, post-tonsillectomy/adenoidectomy patients under 18, significant respiratory depression, acute/severe asthma without monitoring, GI obstruction, hypersensitivity, and MAOI use within 14 days.
Reserve for appropriate severe pain, start with the lowest effective dose, reassess frequently, and avoid abrupt discontinuation in dependent patients.
Mean peak plasma concentrations occur at about 2 hours for tramadol and 3 hours for the active M1 metabolite after oral dosing in healthy adults.
Mean terminal plasma elimination half-lives are 6.3 ± 1.4 hours for racemic tramadol and 7.4 ± 1.4 hours for racemic M1.
Tramadol is eliminated mainly through hepatic metabolism; metabolites are eliminated mainly by the kidneys, and renal or hepatic impairment prolongs exposure.
Benzodiazepines/CNS depressants, serotonergic drugs, MAOIs, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4 modifiers, and mixed agonist-antagonist opioids can cause dangerous interactions.
Monitor respiratory status, sedation, pain/function, misuse, seizures, serotonin toxicity, and withdrawal.
Prolonged pregnancy use can cause neonatal opioid withdrawal; available data do not establish a clear major-malformation risk.
Breastfeeding is not recommended because ultrarapid CYP2D6 metabolism can increase infant opioid exposure.
Overdose can cause respiratory depression, coma, seizures, cardiac arrest, and death; support ventilation and use naloxone while recognizing seizure risk and incomplete nonopioid reversal.
Tramadol combines mu-opioid action with monoamine reuptake inhibition, so both opioid toxicity and serotonin syndrome/seizures matter.

categories.path: 自泌素 > Eicosanoid > PGI2類似物/IP受器致效

items.text: Treprostinil：PGI2類似物/IP受器致效 → cAMP↑，肺血管擴張並抑制血小板。
用於：肺動脈高壓。
考點：prostacyclin類治PAH，讓肺血管放鬆。
常考/禁忌：潮紅、頭痛、低血壓、下顎痛、出血風險；輸注部位疼痛。

mnemonics.text: p.60: 吹捧(trepro-)伊龍馬(ilo-)，apple pro(epopro-)隨便挑 (select-)。
p.60: 一破破(Epopro-)，一籮破(Ilopro-)，大破特破(Tepro-)→抑制血小 板凝集
p.60: 姨婆(Epo-)在百貨一樓(ilo-)select包包(selexipag)，櫃姐吹捧 (Trepro-)她不像其他廢物(預防肺動脈高壓)一樣，是一位愛(PGI2)包達 人

statements.text: Directly dilates pulmonary and systemic arterial vascular beds and inhibits platelet aggregation.
Reduces pulmonary and systemic vascular resistance and produces dose-related vasodilation and platelet effects.
Improves exercise capacity and symptoms in PAH and can maintain benefit during transition from epoprostenol in selected patients.
Treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension to diminish exercise-associated symptoms and transition of selected patients from epoprostenol.
Common reactions include infusion-site pain/reaction, headache, diarrhea, nausea, jaw pain, vasodilation/flushing, edema, and hypotension.
Serious risks include abrupt-withdrawal deterioration, symptomatic hypotension, bleeding, and catheter-related bloodstream infection with IV delivery.
The reviewed REMODULIN label lists no formal contraindications.
Do not abruptly stop or sharply reduce infusion; use meticulous catheter care and caution in hypotension or bleeding risk.
Steady state is reached in about 10 hours; terminal half-life is approximately 4 hours and hepatic CYP2C8 metabolism is important.
Subcutaneous and intravenous administration are bioequivalent at steady state, with approximately complete systemic availability.
Antihypertensives/vasodilators increase hypotension risk, anticoagulants/antiplatelets increase bleeding risk, and CYP2C8 inhibitors such as gemfibrozil can raise exposure.
Monitor infusion continuity/site or catheter infection, blood pressure, bleeding, PAH symptoms, and liver-based dose tolerance.
Available pregnancy data are insufficient to determine a drug-associated risk.
Human-milk data are unavailable; consider breastfeeding benefits, maternal need, and potential infant risk.
Overdose generally produces exaggerated vasodilator effects such as flushing, headache, hypotension, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea; reduce or interrupt dose with supportive care.
Treprostinil is the comparatively longer-half-life parenteral prostacyclin analogue, but continuous infusion still must not be abruptly interrupted.

categories.path: 感染科 > 抗生素 > DHFR抑制

items.text: Trimethoprim：抑制細菌/原蟲DHFR → THF下降 → DNA合成下降。
用於：TMP常與SMX合用治UTI、PJP、Nocardia、MRSA皮膚；pyrimethamine治toxoplasma/瘧疾合併。
考點：抗葉酸「後段」；與 sulfonamide 串聯阻斷葉酸路徑。
常考/禁忌：骨髓抑制/巨球性貧血、高鉀（TMP）；可用leucovorin救部分毒性。

statements.text: Trimethoprim selectively inhibits bacterial dihydrofolate reductase, sequentially following sulfamethoxazole's dihydropteroate-synthase inhibition.
Sequential blockade reduces tetrahydrofolate-dependent nucleotide synthesis and makes the combination generally bactericidal in vitro.
The fixed combination treats susceptible bacterial infections and Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia.
Labeled fixed-combination uses include selected UTIs, otitis media, bronchitis exacerbations, shigellosis, PJP, and travelers' diarrhea.
Common reactions are nausea, vomiting, anorexia, rash, and urticaria.
Serious risks include marrow suppression, hyperkalemia, severe skin reactions, hepatic injury, pulmonary injury, and anaphylaxis.

Contraindications include component hypersensitivity, prior immune thrombocytopenia, folate-deficiency megaloblastic anemia, age under 2 months, marked hepatic damage, unmonitorable severe renal insufficiency, and dofetilide.
Trimethoprim can cause hyperkalemia and folate-related hematologic toxicity, especially with renal impairment or interacting drugs.
Trimethoprim is rapidly absorbed and generally reaches peak blood concentrations 1 to 4 hours after oral dosing.
Mean serum half-lives are approximately 10 hours for sulfamethoxazole and 8 to 10 hours for trimethoprim; both are prolonged in severe renal impairment.
Warfarin, phenytoin, methotrexate, digoxin, hypoglycemics, RAAS blockers, and dofetilide require particular attention.
Monitor CBC, creatinine/renal function, potassium, liver tests, hydration, and interacting-drug effects.
Folate antagonism can cause fetal harm; use in pregnancy only when benefit justifies risk.
Trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole are present in milk; neonatal kernicterus/hemolysis risk limits use in vulnerable infants.
Overdose can cause gastrointestinal, neurologic, renal, electrolyte, and hematologic toxicity; supportive care and serial laboratory monitoring are required.
Trimethoprim blocks bacterial DHFR; in TMP-SMX the two sequential folate blocks produce the tested synergy.

categories.path: 毒物學 > 螯合劑

items.text: Unithiol：機轉：dithiol 螯合劑（DMPS），以硫氫基結合砷/汞等重金屬 → 水溶性複合物尿排。
用於：砷、汞等重金屬中毒（依地區用藥）。
一句話：Unithiol/DMPS靠兩個-SH抓金屬。
常考：噁心、皮疹、低血壓、肝腎監測。

mnemonics.text: p.125: 特殊的厲害(unique又多用途)

statements.text: Two vicinal sulfhydryl groups form stable complexes with heavy metals, reducing toxicity and promoting predominantly renal elimination.
Increases urinary excretion of mercury and lead and can also chelate several other metals documented in the SmPC evidence section.
Reduces body burden in clinically manifest acute or chronic mercury poisoning and chronic lead poisoning under the regional label.
Clinically manifest acute/chronic mercury poisoning and chronic lead poisoning under the DIMAVAL capsule SmPC.
Uncommon allergic reactions include fever, chills, and rash; nausea can also occur.
Rare leukopenia and very rare severe cutaneous reactions such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome are clinically important.
Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to DMPS or product excipients.
Stop treatment for allergic reactions; during prolonged therapy monitor urinary toxic-metal and essential-trace-element excretion.
After oral dosing, urinary recovery peaks about 2 to 3 hours and roughly half of the dose is detected in urine.
Approximately 90% is protein bound and elimination is predominantly renal, without accumulation during repeated treatment in the reviewed data.
Do not take simultaneously with mineral supplements, activated charcoal, or food; administer about one hour before meals.
Monitor clinical toxicity, urinary metal excretion, CBC if symptoms suggest leukopenia, liver tests, and zinc/copper balance during longer treatment.
Human pregnancy experience is inadequate; use only after careful risk assessment and monitor zinc/other minerals if treatment is necessary.
Mothers with heavy-metal contamination should not breastfeed because transfer of the toxic metal, rather than only DMPS, is the concern.
Oral overdose has not been reported in the SmPC; excessive parenteral exposure caused hypotension, weakness, and nausea, and DMPS is dialyzable.
Prussian blue—not DMPS—is the labeled antidote for radioactive cesium and radioactive or nonradioactive thallium; the legacy 鉈/銫 mnemonic is reassigned accordingly.

items.text: Valproic acid：多重機轉：↑GABA、阻Na+通道、阻T-type Ca2+通道。
用於：廣效抗癲癇；bipolar躁期；偏頭痛預防。
考點：廣效但孕婦禁忌；會抑制CYP。
常考/禁忌：肝毒性、胰臟炎、體重增加、震顫、掉髮、血小板低下；神經管缺陷。

mnemonics.text: p.34: CNN(阻Ca2+ Na+通道)說蒸發的(evaporate🡺valproic)最廣效，小心肝就好

statements.text: The mechanism has not been established; increasing brain gamma-aminobutyric acid concentrations has been proposed.
Suppresses multiple seizure types, but concentration-response relationships are influenced by nonlinear protein binding.
Reduces complex partial and simple/complex absence seizures as monotherapy or adjunctive therapy within labeled use.
Monotherapy or adjunctive therapy for complex partial seizures and simple/complex absence seizures, including multiple seizure types that include absence seizures.
Common reactions include nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, somnolence, tremor, dizziness, weight change, alopecia, and thrombocytopenia.
Serious risks include fatal hepatotoxicity, major congenital malformations/neurodevelopmental harm, pancreatitis, hyperammonemia, thrombocytopenia, and severe skin reactions.
Contraindicated in significant hepatic disease, POLG-related mitochondrial disorders, urea-cycle disorders, hypersensitivity, and pregnancy for migraine prevention.
Monitor closely for liver failure, pancreatitis, hyperammonemic encephalopathy, bleeding/cytopenia, suicidality, and hypothermia.
Mean terminal half-life for valproate monotherapy is 9 to 16 hours after oral dosing.
Valproate is metabolized mainly by hepatic glucuronidation and mitochondrial beta oxidation; less than 3% of a dose is excreted unchanged in urine.
Absorption rate varies by formulation and food, while total bioavailability is generally comparable across oral valproate products.
Important interactions include enzyme-inducing antiseizure drugs, lamotrigine, carbapenems, aspirin, warfarin, topiramate, and CNS depressants.
Monitor liver tests, CBC/platelets/coagulation, serum valproate when clinically useful, pregnancy prevention, ammonia for compatible symptoms, and pancreatic symptoms.
Valproate can cause major birth defects and neurodevelopmental harm; avoid in pregnancy unless no acceptable alternative exists for the treated condition.
Valproate is present in human milk; consider breastfeeding benefits and maternal need, and monitor the infant for jaundice or unusual bruising or bleeding.
Children under two years, especially with mitochondrial/metabolic disease or polytherapy, have the greatest fatal-hepatotoxicity risk.
Overdose can cause somnolence, heart block, deep coma, hypernatremia, and death; supportive care, extracorporeal removal, and naloxone in selected cases may be considered.
Valproate is broad-spectrum but the current label does not establish the mnemonic's exact Ca2+/Na+ channel wording; hepatotoxicity and pregnancy risk are firmly supported.

categories.path: 感染科 > 抗生素 > Glycopeptide

items.text: Vancomycin：結合D-Ala-D-Ala，阻斷peptidoglycan延長/交聯 → G+細胞壁合成停止。
用於：MRSA、嚴重G+感染、C. difficile（口服vancomycin）。
考點：Gram+大砲；口服不吸收所以可留在腸腔治C. diff。
常考/禁忌：腎毒性、耳毒性、red man syndrome（vancomycin輸注過快）、中性球低下。

statements.text: Binds D-alanyl-D-alanine precursors and inhibits cell-wall polymerization; membrane permeability and RNA synthesis may also be affected.
Bactericidal activity is generally associated with exposure relative to organism susceptibility, while nephrotoxicity risk increases with excessive exposure.
Treats serious susceptible Gram-positive infections, including methicillin-resistant staphylococcal disease, via intravenous delivery.
Treatment of serious infections caused by susceptible staphylococci and other indicated Gram-positive organisms when intravenous therapy is appropriate.
Infusion reactions, phlebitis, nephrotoxicity, rash, fever, and neutropenia are recurring reactions.
Serious risks include acute kidney injury, ototoxicity, severe infusion reactions, DRESS/SJS/TEN/AGEP, neutropenia, and superinfection.
Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to vancomycin.
Infuse over at least 60 minutes and monitor renal function and drug exposure; stop for severe cutaneous or hypersensitivity reactions.
With normal renal function the elimination half-life is typically about 4 to 6 hours.
Approximately 75% of an intravenous dose is excreted in urine within 24 hours; renal impairment markedly prolongs elimination.
Other nephrotoxic or ototoxic agents and anesthetic coadministration can increase toxicity or infusion reactions.
Monitor renal function, serum concentrations/AUC according to clinical context, infusion tolerance, hearing in at-risk patients, and CBC during prolonged therapy.
Available intravenous pregnancy experience has not identified a clear major-birth-defect signal, but product-specific excipients and maternal disease must be considered.
Vancomycin is present in human milk; weigh breastfeeding benefits, maternal need, and potential infant effects.
Provide supportive care with glomerular filtration monitoring; high-flux dialysis/hemofiltration may enhance removal more than conventional dialysis.
Intravenous vancomycin is for systemic infection; oral absorption is poor and oral therapy is a separate product/route concept for intestinal infection.

categories.path: 血液腫瘤科 > 抗癌 > Vinca alkaloids

items.text: Vincristine：結合β-tubulin，抑制微小管聚合 → M期有絲分裂停住。
用於：ALL、淋巴瘤等化療組合。
考點：Vinca『不讓微小管長』；vincristine最常考神經毒性。
常考/禁忌：周邊神經病變、自主神經便祕/腸阻塞；骨髓抑制較vinblastine少。

mnemonics.text: p.101: “V”的兩端是分開的🡺微管聚不起來

statements.text: Binds tubulin, disrupts microtubule formation and mitotic spindle function, and arrests dividing cells in metaphase.
Antimitotic activity is accompanied by dose-limiting peripheral and autonomic neurotoxicity.
Produces antineoplastic activity in acute leukemia and as part of combination regimens for multiple pediatric and adult malignancies.
Acute leukemia and combination therapy for Hodgkin/non-Hodgkin lymphoma and selected other malignancies.
Alopecia, peripheral neuropathy, constipation, jaw pain, and loss of deep tendon reflexes are common or characteristic.
Fatal intrathecal administration, severe neurotoxicity, paralytic ileus, SIADH/hyponatremia, seizures, and tissue injury from extravasation are major hazards.
Contraindicated in the demyelinating form of Charcot-Marie-Tooth syndrome; never administer intrathecally.
For intravenous use only; verify route, prevent extravasation, and reduce dose in hepatic impairment.
After rapid intravenous injection, the initial, middle, and terminal half-lives are approximately 5 minutes, 2.3 hours, and 85 hours, respectively; the terminal range is 19 to 155 hours.
Vincristine is metabolized by hepatic CYP3A-family enzymes.
About 80% of an injected dose appears in feces and 10% to 20% in urine.
Strong CYP3A inhibitors, particularly azole antifungals, can increase neurotoxicity; phenytoin concentrations and seizure control may be altered.
Monitor neurologic examination, bowel function, CBC, electrolytes/SIADH, hepatic function, and the injection site.
Can cause fetal harm based on mechanism and animal data; use requires pregnancy-risk counseling.
Because serious infant reactions are possible, discontinue nursing or the drug after weighing maternal need.
Overdose causes exaggerated neurotoxicity, ileus, seizures, SIADH, and marrow toxicity; treatment is supportive with intensive monitoring.
Vincristine is the neurotoxic vinca alkaloid with comparatively less marrow suppression; intrathecal administration is fatal.

categories.path: 血液腫瘤科 > 抗凝血 > Vitamin K antagonist

items.text: Warfarin：抑制VKORC1 → vitamin K不能再生 → II, VII, IX, X與Protein C/S γ-carboxylation下降。
用於：AF、DVT/PE、機械瓣膜抗凝。
考點：起初Protein C先降會暫時促凝，需heparin bridge；監測INR。
常考/禁忌：出血、皮膚壞死、purple toe、致畸；交互作用多。解毒：vitamin K、PCC/FFP。

statements.text: Inhibits VKORC1, reducing regeneration of reduced vitamin K and hepatic synthesis of factors II, VII, IX, and X and proteins C and S.
Anticoagulant effect begins within about 24 hours, peaks after roughly 72 to 96 hours, and can persist 2 to 5 days after a dose.
Prevents and treats venous thromboembolism and reduces thromboembolic complications in atrial fibrillation, prosthetic valves, and selected post-MI settings.
Prophylaxis/treatment of venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism and reduction of thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation, valve replacement, and after myocardial infarction.
Bleeding is the principal and most common adverse reaction; bruising, epistaxis, GI or urinary bleeding may occur.
Major or fatal hemorrhage, tissue necrosis, gangrene, calciphylaxis, cholesterol microembolization, and fetal harm are serious risks.

Contraindications include pregnancy except selected mechanical-valve situations, hemorrhagic tendencies, recent/high-risk surgery, uncontrolled severe hypertension, and inability to perform adequate monitoring.
Individualize dose by INR and reassess whenever illness, diet, adherence, or interacting medications change.
Warfarin is essentially completely absorbed, reaches peak concentration within about 4 hours, and is approximately 99% protein bound.
The effective half-life of warfarin ranges from 20 to 60 hours, with a mean of about 40 hours; the terminal half-life after a single dose is approximately one week.
Warfarin has extensive drug, botanical, food, alcohol, and disease interactions through coagulation, platelet, absorption, and CYP pathways.
Monitor INR at intervals appropriate to stability and more often after dose, medication, diet, illness, or adherence changes; assess all bleeding symptoms.
Warfarin can cause fetal harm and is generally contraindicated in pregnancy, with narrow risk-benefit exceptions for selected mechanical heart valves.
Warfarin was not detected in milk in limited data and is not expected to cause adverse effects in breastfed infants; monitor clinically as appropriate.
Reverse excessive anticoagulation according to severity using vitamin K and, for serious bleeding, factor replacement such as four-factor PCC with supportive measures.
Warfarin lowers both procoagulant factors and proteins C/S; delayed full effect and early protein-C decline explain bridging considerations in high-risk starts.
